title: Issues of the European and International Economy in the Era of Globalization
summary: Globalization provides many challenges for the economies of Europe and beyond. The eleven papers in this Festschrift approach economic globalization from a theoretical, empirical, and policy perspective. Issues covered include international trade, the European Monetary Union, debt crises, fiscal policy, environmental policy, corporate policy, economic institutions and oil prices. There is a focus on European economic issues; however, Latin America, USA and Japan are also covered.
